This is action-space evidence, not a new defect on any screened application.
whole_bridge_interface.mgcrea: Typed text/ID send constructs empty references; write-enabled a2a_request permits SendMessage/GetTask and arbitrary native params, forwarding them unchanged. Native references/parts/metadata must be assessed with that permitted raw path, equally available to strong comparators. Source tools/request.ts:8-24,37-77 and client/peer.ts:182/rawRpc. No whole-interface field loss is concluded.
whole_bridge_interface.screened_applications: Calculator/Echo consume first text and do not require structured parts/refs/metadata; ordinary text is sufficient at source level if version/transport fit. SDK metadata status selection is a simulator control, not independently existing continuation behavior. No actionable discriminating native continuation control selected.
